title: An Approximate Conjugate Subgradient Algorithm with Matrix Parameter for Derivative-Free Nonsmooth Optimization Problems
summary: We propose a derivative-free matrix conjugate-subgradient method for unconstrained nonsmooth optimization of locally Lipschitz functions. The method constructs discrete gradients using only function values and forms a finite sampled model of the Goldstein subdifferential. A minimal-norm element of the convex hull of the sampled discrete gradients is then computed and used both as a stationarity measure and as the reference vector for generating descent-oriented directions.
